media.title: Les Nuits moscovites (1934) — film poster
media.description: French poster for Les Nuits moscovites (1934): “Sédif présente” Annabella, Harry-Baur, Spinelly, P. Richard Willm and Germaine Dermoz in a film by Alexis Granowsky, inspired by an unpublished story by Pierre Benoit; G. G. Films production. The poster does not name the composers.
media.altText: Film poster for Les Nuits moscovites (1934), with painted portraits of Annabella, Harry Baur and Pierre Richard-Willm before Moscow domes.
media.rightsNote: IMDb supplies no reuse licence for this French film poster of 1934, whose artist is not identified here; rights are presumed to subsist. The image is classified as restricted.
